```{bash Get sample Ids}
#| eval: false
mkdir ../../data/raw/GSE274934/ATAC

# Get SRP for our given GSE (experiment)
pysradb gse-to-srp GSE274934

# Get metadata and GSM Ids and Sample Ids
pysradb metadata SRP526658 | grep 'ATAC-seq' | cut -f 4 | \
awk -F'[:,]' '{gsub(/^ /,"",$2); print $1 "," $2}' > data/raw/GSE274934/ATAC/GSM_IDS_and_Sample_IDS.txt
cat ../../data/raw/GSE274934/ATAC/GSM_IDS_and_Sample_IDS.txt
```

```{python Snakemake script}

#| eval: false
#| echo: false

gsm_ids = config["single_cell_ATAC"]["gsm_ids"]
sample_ids = config["single_cell_ATAC"]["sample_ids"]


ATAC_FILES = ["fragments.tsv.gz", "peaks.bed.gz", "singlecell.csv.gz"]


def atac_url(gsm, sample, filename):
  return f"https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/samples/{gsm[:7]}nnn/{gsm}/suppl/{gsm}_{sample}_ATAC_{filename}"


def output_path(gsm, sample, filename):
    return f"data/raw/GSE274934/ATAC/{gsm}_{sample}_ATAC_{filename}"


all_files = expand(output_path(gsm = gsm_ids, sample = sample_ids, filename = ATAC_FILES),
                   gsm = gsm_ids, sample = sample_ids, filename = ATAC_FILES)


rule all:
  input:
    all_files

rule download_atac_files:
  output:
    path = "data/raw/GSE274934/ATAC/{gsm}_{sample}_ATAC_{filename}"
  params:
    url = lambda wildcards: atac_url(wildcards.gsm, wildcards.sample, wildcards.filename)
  shell:
    """
    wget -nc {params.url} -O {output.path}
    """

```


```{bash}
snakemake -s scripts/snakemake_scripts/GSE274934_ATAC_workflow.smk -p --cores 8
```


```{python}
import glob 
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import muon as mu
import scvi
import scanpy as sc
import os
import pandas as pd

def run_scvi_atac_multi_inmemory(
    adata_paths,
    output_dir,
    min_counts=1000,
    min_cells=10,
    max_epochs=100,
    early_stopping=True,
    use_umap=True
):
    adata_list = []
    print(f"Loading {len(adata_paths)} datasets...")

    for path in adata_paths:
        print(f"Loading {path} ...")
        mdata = mu.read_10x_h5(path)
        ad = mdata["atac"]
        sample_name = os.path.basename(path).split("_")[1]  # extract sample ID
        ad.obs["sample"] = sample_name
        adata_list.append(ad)

    print("Concatenating datasets...")
    adata = sc.concat(adata_list, label="sample", index_unique="-", join = "outer")

    print(f"adata shape before filtering: {adata.shape}")

    print("Filtering cells and peaks...")
    sc.pp.filter_cells(adata, min_counts=min_counts)
    sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=min_cells)


    print("Setting up AnnData for scvi ATAC model...")
    scvi.model.PEAKVI.setup_anndata(adata)

    print("Creating and training SCVI model...")
    model = scvi.model.PEAKVI(adata)
    model.train(max_epochs=max_epochs, early_stopping=early_stopping, accelerator = "mps")

    print("Getting latent representation...")
    latent = model.get_latent_representation()
    adata.obsm["X_scVI"] = latent

    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    adata_file = os.path.join(output_dir, "adata_scvi_atac_combined.h5ad")
    print(f"Saving AnnData to {adata_file}...")
    adata.write_h5ad(adata_file)

   
    if use_umap:
        print("Computing UMAP embedding...")
        sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep="X_scVI")
        sc.tl.umap(adata)

        
        print("Plotting UMAP colored by sample...")
        sc.pl.umap(adata, color="sample", show=True)
    
    print("scVI ATAC workflow completed!")
    return adata, model


h5_files_dir = "data/raw/GSE274934/ATAC"

adata_paths = glob.glob(os.path.join(h5_files_dir, "*_filtered_peak_bc_matrix.h5"))

output_dir = "results/GSE274934/ATAC/figures"

adata, model = run_scvi_atac_multi_inmemory(
    adata_paths=adata_paths,
    output_dir=output_dir,
    min_counts=500,
    min_cells=5,
    max_epochs=100,
    early_stopping=True,
    use_umap=True
)

```
